candidate_identity.candidate_vector_hash_input: canonical compact UTF-8 JSON array of the 48 values in physical_candidate_order; no BOM and no trailing newline
candidate_identity.physical_candidate_items_encoding: canonical compact UTF-8 JSON array of the exact 48 pair records in physical_candidate_order; no BOM and no trailing newline
candidate_identity.type_rule: each value must have the exact built-in integer or string type required by calibration-plan-v2; booleans, floats, subclasses, missing fields, extra fields, duplicate names, reordered names, and ordinal-factor mismatches are rejected
candidate_identity.validation_rule: authenticate calibration-plan-v2 and its bound dependencies, reconstruct the exact physical candidate, validate materialized identity, compare exact pair bytes, then compare SHA-256 of the canonical 48-value array

canonicalization.file_serialization: canonical JSON followed by exactly one LF
canonicalization.hash_scope: canonical sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON excluding /artifact_sha256

authenticated_adapter_identity.canonical_bytes: canonical sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON object; no BOM and no trailing newline

control_execution_producer_identity.construction_rule: construct only from the exact live NativeCandidateAdapterFactory product and the authenticated source files after every digest relation has been independently recomputed; artifact evidence cannot manufacture or override producer identity

adapter_configuration_sha256.verification: must equal SHA-256 of canonical compact UTF-8 JSON for CandidateAdapter.configuration and NativeCandidateCallable.adapter_configuration_sha256

configuration_artifact_boundary.rule: configuration and artifact semantic inputs remain independently complete-byte and SHA-256 bound; they are not substituted for, duplicated into, or omitted by the Python implementation-source identity
configuration_artifact_boundary.swift_boundary: compiled Swift sources, toolchain, SDK, and flags remain independently bound by native_source_manifest_sha256 and native_executable_sha256

native_executable_sha256.verification: reopen the exact regular executable without following symlinks and hash its complete bytes; require executable permission and equality with CandidateAdapter.configuration#/swift_cli/executable_sha256

native_implementation_source_sha256.verification: securely reopen every exact ordered Python source, validate path, role, order, size, and complete-file SHA-256, construct the canonical manifest, and hash its canonical bytes

native_source_manifest_sha256.verification: reopen exact source-manifest.json bytes, reject noncanonical JSON or changed source/toolchain/SDK/flag records, hash complete bytes, and require equality with CandidateAdapter.configuration#/swift_cli/source_manifest_sha256

downstream_bindings.rule: the producer must authenticate this contract before identity construction, and every listed consumer must bind and verify all three authority digests before accepting the producer identity
downstream_bindings.source_set_boundary: downstream consumer source files are not members of the producer implementation-source manifest

execution_boundary.required_successor_before_execution: a concrete provider implementation and all downstream bindings must authenticate this contract and pass focused adversarial tests before any control execution

implementation_source_identity.hash_input: canonical sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON of the exact manifest object; no BOM and no trailing newline
implementation_source_identity.record_validation: order must be the zero-based array index; path and role must exactly equal the preregistered source set; size_bytes must equal the complete opened byte count; sha256 must be nonzero lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of those exact bytes; pre-open, opened-descriptor, and post-read regular-file identity and size must agree
implementation_source_identity.versioning_rule: a successor authority with a new domain separator is required before adding, removing, reordering, renaming, or changing the meaning of any source role or manifest field
